cc:Work.dc:title: time scaling
cc:Work.dc:description: Identical linear axes, pooled median/Q1/Q3 and three same-session medians. Connecting lines are visual guides. Native Rust, system allocator · genanki 0.13.1 / CPython 3.11.0 · Apple M1 Pro · arm64. Full numeric and per-session tables: report.md.
